decisions.reason: Changing prize delivery from winner-initiated claiming to automatic wallet transfer does not alter winner selection, Chainlink VRF, on-chain execution, fairness, or verification.
The existing message-184 MODIFY already replaces one-click prize claiming with automatic wallet delivery in both reward_collection and the fiat-buyer rewards FAQ.
The existing message-184 MODIFY already replaces the one-click claim wording in process_copy with direct delivery to the winner's wallet.
The source changes prize payout behavior, while referral commissions were already transferred automatically and remain unchanged.
The Big Block draw's amount, cadence, funding, qualifying sales, and winner eligibility remain valid independently of the post-selection payout interaction.
The Small Block draw's amount, cadence, funding, qualifying sales, and winner eligibility remain valid independently of the post-selection payout interaction.
Automatic prize transfer does not alter Big Block ticket issuance, weighting, eligibility, independence, or post-draw reset behavior.
The payout-method decision does not resolve whether Aave prize-pool yield integration should be retained or removed.
Prize-winner email notification is independently introduced by message 184 and remains valid regardless of whether payout is automatic or claim-based.
The existing message-184 MODIFY already records that the provisioned wallet holds prizes and that fiat buyers can access it through the dashboard or SIWE.
Automatic prize transfer does not alter Small Block ticket issuance, weighting, eligibility, carryover, or post-draw reset behavior.
Changing how winners receive prizes does not change the primary mint price, founder allocation, affiliate commission allocation, or prize-pool funding split.
